role: Male Lead, villainous prime minister in the future, currently a crippled fugitive

appearance.face: Handsome but terrifying. Narrow phoenix eyes with cold killing intent. High straight nose bridge, thin bloodless lips. Deep dark circles under eyes from suffering and sleeplessness. Ghastly pale complexion with blue veins faintly visible.
appearance.hair: Long dark lank hair, slightly disheveled but hanging straight.
appearance.body: Tall but currently gaunt, gaunt and thin from imprisonment and torture. Currently disabled from the waist down, sitting in a dilapidated wheelchair.
appearance.clothing: Dark-colored coarse robes, worn and slightly stained, but worn with an innate oppressive dignity. Black boots.

personality: Ruthless, highly intelligent, paranoid, deeply cynical, completely merciless but maintains a calm, almost amused facade of cold mockery.
